summary: Missing woman reported in the Watson Divide area ~7 miles west of Aspen; left phone, car, and belongings at a residence and left on foot; multi-agency search through the night and resumed next day; located Nov 5 ~11 AM and transported to Aspen Valley Hospital.
location: Watson Divide, ~7 miles west of Aspen
responding_agency: Mountain Rescue Aspen; Pitkin County Sheriff's Office; Colorado Search and Rescue (CSAR); West Elk SAR; Gunnison, Vail Mountain, Eagle County, Summit County, Lake County, Garfield County SAR; Front Range Rescue Dogs; Roaring Fork Fire Rescue; Aspen Ambulance District
notes: Incident date Nov 4 (reported 'the previous day'); found Nov 5.
